name: Export
description: Exporters that turn a scene into other formats: one frame as an SVG document, a scene as a Lottie JSON document with animated position, scale, rotation and opacity, and gradient stop alpha, and the frame plan (numbers, times, pixel sizes, file names) for a numbered PNG sequence. Output is byte-stable and throws on non-finite values. W1 writers fill one seam file each: SVGExporter+Style (paint at the frame), SVGExporter+Text (text runs), SVGExporter+Masks and LottieExporter+Masks (layer masks and track mattes), LottieExporter+Tracks (animated properties, including colour, width and shape keys).
